name: – Nils Ušakovs – § 27 – Am 71
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 27. Observes that enhanced funding for border protection capabilities, as provided for in the annex III to the BMVI Regulation26 , is a cornerstone of a comprehensive migration policy to preserve the free movement of people within the EU and to address evolving migration and security challenges, including those of a hybrid nature; stresses that credible migration management requires a significant improvement in return rates; calls for adequate management in the implementation of the forthcoming EU framework for returns, including through strengthened cooperation with third countries and the exploration of innovative solutions; reaffirms the vital importance of the implementation of the Asylum and Migration Pact, including the role of the Integrated Border Management Fund and the BMVI in safeguarding the EU’s external borders; reaffirms that cooperation agreements on migration and asylum management with third countries, in full respect of international law and the EU Charter, can help prevent and counter irregular migration, tackle smuggling, combat organised crime and strengthen border security; recalls the necessity for adequate funding, staffing and staff training for all agencies operating in the field of security, justice, law enforcement, asylum and migration, as well as border management; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 26 Regulation (EU) 2021/1148 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 7 July 2021 establishing, as part of the Integrated Border Management Fund, the Instrument for Financial Support for Border Management and Visa Policy (OJ L 251, 15.7.2021, p. 48 ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2021/1148/oj).
